LESSON: BIRTH OF JESUS

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 3.1: Birth of Jesus
Suggested lessons in curriculum: as per KICD

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Birth of Jesus under CHRISTIAN. It is aligned with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) CBC design.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Birth of Jesus together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learners will role play while talking, singing, dancing and telling simple stories on how Jesus was born.
Citizenship: Patriotism, unity as they identify their birthplace
Learning to learn: Learners will demonstrate understanding of the birth of Jesus Christ.
Self-Efficacy: Knowing and appreciating their birthday just as Jesus was born
Digital literacy: Learners view video clip on the birth of Jesus
